_about: Candidate lots shown on the map. status: forlease | vacant | abandoned | closed. Each entry has a source link. Photos come from Google Street View and may be older than the status — the photo date is shown on the card.

lots.name: Industrial building — 801 S 16th St
lots.note: 'For lease — industrial space' sign on the fence along E Grant St. Large fenced industrial lot, ~24 ac.

lots.name: Office building — 2211 S 47th St
lots.address: 2211 S 47th St, Phoenix, AZ 85034 (entrance on E Hilton Ave)
lots.note: Vacant office building. Gated entrance with arm barriers off E Hilton Ave; large covered parking lot, ~7.8 ac.

lots.name: Office building — 2299 W Obispo Ave
lots.note: Vacant multi-story office. Open surface parking in front, no gate at the Obispo Ave entrance, ~6.7 ac.

lots.name: Former Sears — Metrocenter
lots.address: 9803 N Metro Pkwy W, Phoenix, AZ 85051
lots.note: Two-story Sears box closed 2020; still standing after the rest of Metrocenter Mall was demolished (2025). ~14.5 ac of empty striped parking around it. Owned by the Sears successor company, not part of the mall redevelopment.

source.label: KJZZ, Sept 2025 — Metrocenter demo done, Sears still standing

lots.name: Former Kmart — 2526 W Northern Ave
lots.note: Kmart closed 2017; building still vacant with an 'AVAILABLE' banner on the front. ~8.3 ac lot. County records show the City of Phoenix now owns the parcel.

lots.name: Former Fry's Electronics — Tempe
lots.note: 149,000 SF big box closed Feb 2021 when Fry's Electronics shut down. ~15 ac site west of I-10 by Arizona Mills. A Costco Business Center conversion was proposed in 2022 but stalled. Confirm on arrival.

source.label: ABC15 — Costco plan for former Fry's (2022)

lots.name: Former Sears + auto center — Superstition Springs
lots.address: 6525 E Southern Ave, Mesa, AZ 85206 (south side of the mall)
lots.note: 113,837 SF two-story Sears (closed 2018) plus 17,050 SF former auto center on ~12.7 ac, sold at auction as a redevelopment site. Apartments have been proposed for the land.

lots.name: Former Safeway — 32nd St & Thunderbird
lots.note: Safeway closed this store in July 2025. Grocery box on a ~10 ac shopping-center parcel; other tenants in the center may still be open, so expect some traffic.

lots.name: Former Safeway — 59th Ave & Thunderbird
lots.note: Safeway closed this store in July 2025. Grocery box on a ~9.6 ac shopping-center parcel; other tenants in the center may still be open.

lots.name: Former movie theater — Bell Canyon Pavilions
lots.note: Theater at the back of the Bell Canyon Pavilions center, closed since 2020; the 32,640 SF building is listed for lease. Shared center lot — quieter at the theater end.

source.label: CommercialCafe — 2710 W Bell Rd, 32,640 SF for lease
